components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid AERYO Teal action. Intent primary, variant solid, size md.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #106B70; color: #EDF8F6; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #19AEB5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2FC3B8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: On photo scrims (Skip). No fill. Type is fg.photo.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #EDF8F6; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(237, 248, 246, 0.08); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #63E6D5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Card
components.description: Panel plus muted hairline. Resting product surface.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #0D2931; color: #EDF8F6; border: 1px solid rgba(99, 230, 213, 0.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 1rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; color: #76A1A9; }

components.name: Interactive Card
components.description: Same as default; hover raises hairline and sm shadow; press scales to 0.99.
components.css: .ds-card-interactive { background: #0D2931; color: #EDF8F6; border: 1px solid rgba(99, 230, 213, 0.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card-interactive:hover { border-color: rgba(99, 230, 213, 0.16); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(2, 8, 10, 0.45); } .ds-card-interactive:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-card-interactive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #19AEB5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; margin: 0; color: #76A1A9; }

components.name: Outline Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #76A1A9; } .ds-input { height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(99, 230, 213, 0.16); border-radius: 8px; background: #0D2931; color: #EDF8F6; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #66969F; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #19AEB5; outline-offset: 0; border-color: #19AEB5; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #D96F62; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Pill is allowed. Semantic status, not a second accent.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #071216; background: #19AEB5; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; }

components.name: Progress Dots
components.description: Onboarding step index on a photo scrim. Decorative, not tappable. fg.photo / fg.photo.muted.
components.css: .ds-dots { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center; } .ds-dot { width: 0.375rem; height: 0.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(237, 248, 246, 0.4); } .ds-dot-active { width: 1.5rem; background: #EDF8F6; }

narrative.overview:
AERYO looks like a precision instrument taken outside: North Sea Ink atmosphere, one AERYO Teal signal, full-bleed photography where emotion belongs, and quiet chrome everywhere else. Wind is not an icon set. It is geometry, motion, and a lime-only data scale.

The interface is refined and restrained. Corners are aerodynamic, not pill-by-default. Teal is for real actions and real status, not decoration. On intro and onboarding, the photograph carries the feeling; type and buttons sit on a dark scrim and stay out of the way.

It must not read as a generic weather dashboard, tropical surf brand, SaaS card farm, or extreme-sports poster.
keyCharacteristics: One primary (AERYO Teal). No second general-purpose highlight.
Photographic full-bleed for brand moments; token surfaces for product chrome.
Hybrid depth: tonal ink steps at rest, real shadow when something floats or is pressable.
Portrait phone in a native shell; safe-area as spacing tokens (`safe.top` and siblings).

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: If a new element wants “a highlight,” use a brighter teal step first, then ask whether it needs one at all. Lime is not a candidate.

rules.name: The Wind Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime lives inside `wind.*` only. Strong wind may go lime; extreme wind is caution, a safety state, not “more lime.”

rules.name: The Color-Plus-Data Rule
rules.body: Condition quality is never color alone. Pair color with icon, label, and a number.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: `border` / `border.muted` are low-contrast decorative edges. Interactive outlines (input, focus, button stroke) need a dedicated stronger boundary (`border.error`, focus ring, or accent).

rules.name: The One Scale Rule
rules.body: Reach for `textStyle` / `Heading`/`Text` variants. Do not invent a parallel size ladder.

rules.name: The Sora Floor Rule
rules.body: Sora never renders below `title` (1.25rem). Anything smaller is Manrope. Chakra heading `size` xs–xl collapses to `title` so a leftover `size="sm"` cannot put Sora on a caption.

rules.name: The Float-When-It-Floats Rule
rules.body: If it is not hovering, popping over, or pressable, prefer tone + hairline over `box-shadow`.

rules.name: The No-Pill-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A pill must earn it (avatar, StatusPill). Primary actions stay `rounded.md`.

dos: Do use `bg` / `fg` / `border` / `accent` semantic tokens so light and dark stay paired. Use `bg.photo` / `fg.photo` on full-bleed photography (those do not flip with color mode).
Do put photography on intro/onboarding and keep product lists on ink panels.
Do mark wind with teal → lime → caution, plus a label and a number.
Do pad full-bleed content with `safe.*` after opting the photo out of body insets.
Do wrap Chakra; consumers import `@/components/...`, never raw palettes for brand color.
donts: Don't add a second brand accent. Mint is teal.300, not a new family.
Don't put Wind Lime on buttons or badges.
Don't use stock Chakra red/orange/green for status; use `danger` / `caution` / `success`.
Don't rely on hairline borders as the only interactive edge.
Don't expose exact GPS as a visual pattern; presence is a status pill, not a live dot on a map in V1.
Don't reach for raw palette steps (`ink.950`, `white`, `whiteAlpha`) in app UI. Name the role in `semantic-tokens.ts` instead.
